chunks: And it is narrated: "It was named Bakkah because of the weeping of the people around it and within it."

key_terms.بَكَّةَ: Bakkah, a name for the sacred sanctuary

ai.seo_question: Why was Bakkah given this name in hadith literature?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a reason for the name Bakkah, linking it to the weeping of people around and within it. It reflects a transmitted explanation connected to the sacred precinct and its association with devotion and emotional humility.
